title: Zuma's Rescue Ranch
specs: Set on 90 acres with beautiful Colorado views
Horses rescued from traumatic situations and cared for as sanctuary members
Long pants required; boots, half-chaps, and helmets available to borrow
Volunteers must attend orientation and mandatory Horsemanship 101 class
Children under 16 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian; under 18 require signed liability waiver
Horses should not carry more than 20% of combined rider and tack weight
Group volunteer scheduling available for groups of 5-20 from 8am-12pm or 1pm-5pm
Facility rentals accommodate up to 60 guests
includes: Private use of indoor party room
Meet-and-greet with horses or miniature horses
Hands-on horse activities such as grooming and learning about horse care
Optional private riding experience for the birthday child, based on age and availability
gap: Exact pricing for birthday party packages not stated
blurb: Guests can celebrate birthdays with private party space and horse activities including grooming, hay rides, and optional riding. The ranch offers facility rentals for events with indoor and outdoor spaces accommodating up to 60 guests. Volunteers can participate in animal care and ranch upkeep after attending orientation and a mandatory Horsemanship 101 class.
extraNote: Birthday party packages and facility rental rates start at $150/hour; additional rates available on request · Volunteering requires signing a liability release waiver · Events with Mini Brew Crew fees based on driving distance; max 3-hour events
